payload.render:
MDT coverage (coverage/1.0.0, definition: union)
  53.1%   95% CI [31.2%, 75.0%]
  17 of 32 multi-specialty patients, over 16 ward-days (16 withheld under the ADR-0005 floor)

Measured from observed bedside co-presence of required specialties.
Never attested, never self-reported. The interval is sampling and
ward-day clustering variation, not a forecast.

params.interpretation: MDT coverage is the fraction of observed multi-specialty patients for whom >=2 of their REQUIRED specialties were simultaneously at the bedside, derived from observed events only (ADR-0006 rule 4). It is measured, never attested. The interval is sampling and ward-day clustering variation in what was observed -- not a forecast, not a target, and not a tolerance. Quote it as 'coverage was X% (95% CI A to B) under the {strategy} definition', never as a bare percentage (ADR-0006 rule 6).
params.numerator: multi-specialty patients with >=1 MDTMoment: >=2 of their REQUIRED specialties simultaneously at the bedside (never merely present)
params.denominator: distinct observed patients whose required set holds >=2 specialties under this strategy
params.ci_method: envelope of a two-stage ward-day cluster bootstrap (2.5/97.5) and the pooled Wilson score interval; the wider bound on each side is reported, so the figure is never narrower than either component
params.clinician_level_breakdown: absent by design, not permission-gated (ADR-0006 rule 5)
